name: Filamentous algae (the periphyton mats)
description: Mat-forming filamentous algae of the lake's shallow littoral zone, the physical scaffolding in which most of the invertebrate web lives. Functional group pooling the source's 25 filamentous algae taxa - Spirogyra, Zygnema, Mougeotia, Oedogonium, Bulbochaete, Oscillatoria, Lyngbya, Phormidium and kin.
